newsitem.title: SLOVAKIA: Slovak May PPI -0.6 pct mo/mo, +3.2 pct yr/yr. [CORRECTED 10:30 GMT]
newsitem.headline: Slovak May PPI -0.6 pct mo/mo, +3.2 pct yr/yr. [CORRECTED 10:30 GMT]

text.p: (Corrects to month-on-month fall in May, rather than rise.)

Slovak producer prices (PPI) fell 0.6 percent, month-on-month, in May, putting prices 3.2 percent higher than in the same month of the previous year, the Slovak Statistical Bureau (SUSR) said on Tuesday.
In April, PPI rose 0.6 percent, month-on-month, making the year-on-year increase 4.8 percent.
